difficultyCoverage.rule: No difficulty band may be unused in a production audit batch.

primeInputCoverage.rule: Prime input numbers must be represented in audit reporting for all applicable CPs.

compositeInputCoverage.rule: Composite input numbers must be represented in audit reporting for all applicable CPs.

primeBaseCoverage.rule: Prime bases must be visible in audit reporting, including selected primes for CP-006 and CP-007.

largestPrimeFactorCoverage.rule: CP-004 must report largest prime factor coverage, including prime inputs where the largest prime factor equals the input number.

smallestPrimeFactorCoverage.rule: CP-005 must report smallest prime factor coverage, including prime inputs where the smallest prime factor equals the input number.

selectedPrimeCoverage.rule: Selected prime values must be represented in audit reporting for CP-006 and CP-007.

exponentZeroPolicy.rule: Selected prime must divide the number. Exponent is always positive. Exponent 0 cases are not active for NS-PF-001.

selectedExponentCoverage.rule: Selected exponent values must be represented in audit reporting for CP-006 and CP-007.

primePowerCoverage.rule: Prime powers must include exponent 1 and repeated-prime cases over audit batches.

distinctFactorCountCoverage.rule: Distinct factor counts must be represented over audit batches.

repeatedFactorCoverage.rule: Numbers with at least one repeated prime factor must appear in audit batches.

numberShapeCoverage.rule: Approved number shapes must be tracked in audit reporting.

questionLanguageCoverage.rule: No runtime-eligible question language ID may be unused in a production audit batch.

explanationCoverage.rule: No runtime-eligible explanation style ID may be unused in a production audit batch.
